name: New Cairo Studio 6
headline: The Serene Suite | A Rooftop Studio @ New Cairo

description.Space:
The studio features a queen size comfortable bed and a breathtaking terrace with a rooftop! It also features a fully loaded kitchenette, microwave, a stove top with cooking utensils, a kettle and a Nespresso coffee machine. Additionally, guests can enjoy a 32inch smart TV for further personal entertainment. 

Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed in the balcony or outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry.
description.Access: This is an entire studio and guests can have access to all of its features.
description.Interaction: Guests can text and call us anytime they need assistance. We'll be happy to address any issues right away.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is peaceful, upscale and safe. Cairo Festival City Mall - considered to be the best mall in New Cairo,  is a 2 minute drive from the apartment.
 
- Cairo International Airport is a 10 min drive.
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive
description.Transit: We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours.
description.Notes:
Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 
- Free of charge street parking is available.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

We had such a great time staying here! The unit was very modern and was great to have the AC unit in both the living room and in the bedroom. The private balcony and being on the top floor was also such a great nice touch to have. 

This was our first time in Cairo and we felt incredibly safe at this location, there was various doors and locks for safety. It is located in New Cairo City, so there were also a variety of sit-down restaurants that were only a short Uber ride away.  We also were able to easily get Ubers from this location and were around 20-30 min from old Cairo, where much of the touristic sites were. 

The team was also incredibly responsive when communicating with them.  We had a bit of an issue finding the unit when we first arrived, but they were super quick to respond. 

Highly recommend if you're looking to be in New Cairo City!

The hosts were incredibly nice and responsive throughout my stay. They had a well-organized package of trips around Egypt, which made exploring so much easier. I decided to book their tour to the pyramids, and that’s when I met Bob, the tour guide. He was absolutely amazing—friendly, knowledgeable, and full of great insights about Egyptian history and culture. What really stood out was his talent for photography; he helped me capture some truly stunning shots that I’ll always treasure. If you’re planning a visit, I highly recommend asking for Bob. You can also check out his work on Ig: @bob_tour_guide_egypt.
